decisions.reason: Replacing a blog keyword with "handmade dolls" does not necessarily change the independently selected blog topics.
The source changes a blog keyword, while this candidate governs the separate campaign keyword list; the source does not change its keyword count or existing selected replacement.
The keyword replacement does not change the obligation to produce and publish three blog articles within the trial window.
The source changes a blog keyword but does not alter the requirement to include search-volume metrics in the campaign keyword research sheet.
